payload.summary: Arrange Aboriginal governance review for the five held cultural formulation records before any is published
payload.detail: Follow-up to #R8HED2 (closed by PR #3412's hold). first-nations-sewb, cultural-explanatory-model, migration-refugee, racism-discrimination and religion-spirituality have release held in src/data/formulation-concepts.json. All carry Indigenous terms, so the clinical sign-off tool refuses them (scripts/lib/indigenous-content.mjs); each needs review under Aboriginal governance, then release set back to published and its search-index entry restored. Changing release is a clinical content change and needs the owner's explicit yes.
